ko.title: 넣은 값과 Play에 저장된 한국 가격 (2026-10-05~10-08)
ko.note: 정확히 10%가 붙은 것은 5,000 → 5,500뿐입니다. 6,900은 10%를 더한 7,590이 아니라 7,500으로, 7,500은 8,250이 아니라 8,000으로 저장됐고, 뒤쪽 규칙은 확인하지 못했습니다.
ko.alt: 단계 그림: 6,900원 입력이 7,500원, 7,500원 입력이 8,000원, 5,000원 입력이 5,500원으로 저장된 순서
ko.caption: 세 번 모두 저장값이 넣은 값보다 높았습니다.

en.title: Korea price in vs stored, Oct 5 to 8, 2026
items: Typed 7,500 (the agent guessed the field was tax-inclusive)
Play had 8,000, and the app showed 8,000
Typed 5,000; Play stored 5,500, read back via the API
en.note: Only 5,000 came out at exactly plus 10%. 6,900 was stored as 7,500 rather than 7,590, and 7,500 as 8,000 rather than 8,250; the rule behind the second is not confirmed.
en.alt: Step diagram: KRW 6,900 in became 7,500, 7,500 in became 8,000, 5,000 in became 5,500
en.caption: The stored price was higher than what went in every time.
